name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray Only, No Backroll)
intent: Spray primer onto bare drywall ceiling without a backroll pass. Used at QT2/QT3 economy when crew capacity doesn't allow a backroller. Faster but produces a slightly more textured laydown that's acceptable on the ceiling because the finish coat will hide the texture.
doctrine: Spray-only prime ceiling, no backroll. Reuses TSK_SPRAY_CEILING_FINISH_ONLY (550 SF/hr) with TRADE_MATERIAL → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier. QT2/QT3 economy fallback when crew capacity doesn't allow a backroller.
